# submitnow

> Free multilingual web UI, browser-first utilities, CLI/MCP tools, and documentation for submitting URL batches via IndexNow to Bing, ChatGPT Search, Microsoft Copilot, Yandex, Seznam.cz, Naver, and Yep.

submitnow (`https://submitnow.dev`) lets site owners and developers submit URL batches (up to 10,000 same-host URLs per request, with automatic sequential batching for larger lists) to `api.indexnow.org` or participating search engine endpoints (Bing, Yandex, Seznam.cz, Naver, Yep) without creating an account or storing keys on a server. Every page is available in English (`/`), Simplified Chinese (`/zh`), and Japanese (`/ja`).

## Core Application

- [IndexNow Batch Submitter](https://submitnow.dev): Submit URLs via IndexNow with multi-endpoint selection, live sitemap URL / sitemap-index import, `lastmod` filtering, automatic host inference, pre-flight key check, auto-batching, local multi-site profiles, and CSV/JSON history export.
- [All IndexNow Tools](https://submitnow.dev/tools): Hub for six free browser-first IndexNow and SEO indexing utilities.

## Browser Utilities

- [IndexNow Key Generator](https://submitnow.dev/tools/indexnow-key-generator): Generate a compliant 8–128 character IndexNow key locally and download the `<key>.txt` verification file.
- [IndexNow Key File Checker](https://submitnow.dev/tools/indexnow-key-checker): Inspect public key files for 404s, soft 404s, off-host redirects, UTF-8 BOMs, and content mismatches.
- [URL Normalizer](https://submitnow.dev/tools/url-normalizer): Normalize URL lists locally, strip fragments and UTM tracking parameters, sort queries, and deduplicate entries.
- [IndexNow URL Batch Builder](https://submitnow.dev/tools/indexnow-batch-builder): Clean pasted URL lists, flag invalid rows, split by hostname, and chunk batches up to 10,000 URLs with per-group and per-batch submission handoff.
- [Sitemap Diff for IndexNow](https://submitnow.dev/tools/sitemap-diff): Fetch remote sitemaps (including nested sitemap indexes and `.xml.gz`) or upload local XML snapshots, filter by `lastmod`, and export added, changed, or removed URLs.
- [IndexNow Code Generator](https://submitnow.dev/tools/indexnow-code-generator): Generate validated JSON payloads, `curl`, JavaScript `fetch`, Python, Go, and GitHub Actions snippets locally.

## Documentation

- [IndexNow Documentation Hub](https://submitnow.dev/docs): Guides, HTTP status code troubleshooting, AI search crawler checklists, and platform integrations.
- [Submit URLs to Bing with IndexNow](https://submitnow.dev/docs/indexnow-bing-submission): End-to-end key setup, batch submission, and pre-flight checklist.
- [IndexNow, AI Search (ChatGPT Search & Copilot) & robots.txt](https://submitnow.dev/docs/guides/ai-search-robots-txt): Connecting IndexNow to Bing/Copilot/ChatGPT Search discovery and configuring `Bingbot`, `OAI-SearchBot`, and `GPTBot`.
- [IndexNow 200: OK](https://submitnow.dev/docs/status-codes/200): Receipt confirmation and post-submission indexing checks.
- [IndexNow 202: Accepted](https://submitnow.dev/docs/status-codes/202): Asynchronous ownership validation and follow-up checks.
- [IndexNow 400: Bad Request](https://submitnow.dev/docs/status-codes/400): Malformed JSON, missing fields, and key format validation.
- [IndexNow 403: Key Not Valid](https://submitnow.dev/docs/status-codes/403): Fixing key-file content, BOM, WAF/CDN, and redirect errors.
- [IndexNow 422: Unprocessable Entity](https://submitnow.dev/docs/status-codes/422): Resolving mixed hosts and `keyLocation` boundary errors.
- [IndexNow 429: Too Many Requests](https://submitnow.dev/docs/status-codes/429): Deduplication, sitemap diffing, and exponential backoff.
- [IndexNow for WordPress](https://submitnow.dev/docs/integrations/wordpress): Single-publisher setup and avoiding plugin conflicts.
- [IndexNow with Next.js](https://submitnow.dev/docs/integrations/nextjs): Hosting `public/<key>.txt`, middleware exclusions, and deploy hooks.
- [IndexNow with Cloudflare Workers](https://submitnow.dev/docs/integrations/cloudflare-workers): Serving key files at the edge and background `waitUntil` submission.
- [IndexNow for Shopify](https://submitnow.dev/docs/integrations/shopify): Avoiding `cdn.shopify.com` off-host redirect and App Proxy traps with edge workers or Hydrogen.
- [IndexNow with GitHub Actions](https://submitnow.dev/docs/integrations/github-actions): Automated post-deploy key checks and delta-only submissions.
- [IndexNow for Astro, Hugo & Static Sites](https://submitnow.dev/docs/integrations/astro-hugo): Static key-file placement and canonical trailing-slash hygiene.
- [Automate IndexNow with CLI & MCP Server](https://submitnow.dev/docs/integrations/cli-and-mcp): Zero-dependency local CLI and stdio MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, and Antigravity.
